title: PAF Human Approval Authority & Continuity Registry Contract (Step 10)
description: Authority Interface AI-2. Makes human gates machine-resolvable without weakening owner authority. The contract mandates a fail-closed default for unmapped obligations and structurally forbids agent approval.

globalRules.description: Must include: approval is never satisfied by silence, elapsed time, agent recommendation, majority, role relabeling, or emergency status; an agent can never be a delegated human authority; unavailable approver forces SAFE_HOLD; unmapped obligations default to non-waivable.

continuityRecordSchema.description: Delegation/pre-authorization records. Must require a named human, explicit scope, criteria, and an expiry; a record missing any of these is invalid.

agentCanApprove.description: Structural, not advisory. A registry instance asserting true is rejected by the contract.
